start_test_server: start an async gRPC test server on a specified port with optional secure credentials
create_extra_generic_handler: create a generic RPC handler to programmatically register extra methods not defined in the proto file
test_UnaryCall: test the UnaryCall servicer method that echoes metadata and returns a SimpleResponse with a compressible payload
test_FullDuplexCall: test the FullDuplexCall servicer method that handles bidirectional streaming with metadata echoing and configurable delays
test_StreamingOutputCall: test the StreamingOutputCall servicer method that yields streaming responses with configurable payload size and interval delays
